headline: Why Lithium Americas and Uranium Energy Stocks Popped Today, But Bloom Energy Stock Dropped
summary: Alternative energy stocks got a boost last week when Congress approved a second stimulus bill to boost the economy that contained large sums of money that would be invested in renewable energy. At least some of the alternative energy stocks likely to benefit from the $35 billion earmarked in that bill for renewable energy projects are booming today, with shares of lithium miner Lithium Americas (NYSE: LAC) rising 8.7% as of 12:05 p.m. EST, and uranium miner Uranium Energy (NYSEMKT: UEC) up 10.4%

headline: Why Nikola, Bloom Energy, and QuantumScape Stocks All Plunged on Friday
summary: After a busy day of trading Friday, shares of electric-truck company Nikola (NASDAQ: NKLA) closed down 5.1%, hydrogen fuel cell company Bloom Energy (NYSE: BE) dropped 4.2%, and solid-state battery researcher QuantumScape (NYSE: QS) did worst of all -- down 16.5%. Despite its recent difficulties, Nikola shares are still up 80% over the past year, Bloom Energy gained 280%, and QuantumScape -- one of the most recent in a series of special purpose acquisition company (SPAC) IPOs -- increased 674%.
